approvedItems.title: Local Identity, Authorization and Governance Policy Architecture
approvedItems.description: Formalize local-first identity, authorization, human governance separation, threat boundaries and approval policy contracts without silently ratifying preliminary quorum rules. ACCEL-20261024 residual extension: Ratify exact external transport action/identity/policy contracts, source authority, bootstrap, nondelegable decisions and migration boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: Specify a unified local-first identity/authorization design with distinct human and AI agent principal types.
Keep technically VERIFIED separate from independent human governance approval; protected operations require required authorized human approvals.
Document local bootstrap/recovery, role configuration, approval receipts, threat model and explicit unresolved policy decisions.
D210-P1 | lead_owner=DMK-210 | Architecture names DMK/Git/CI/document authorities and one policy evaluation path for direct/local/GitHub/manual actions.
D210-P2 | lead_owner=DMK-210 | Document public minimal discovery, authenticated bootstrap, scoped mutations and independent human authorization as separate admission classes.
D210-N1 | lead_owner=DMK-210 | Transport/vendor identity, prompt text or skill retrieval cannot create a second policy engine or substitute human authority.
D210-N2 | lead_owner=DMK-210 | No architecture/document merge declares proposed owners registered/complete or weakens existing SO/LA quorum.

approvedItems.title: Persistent Local Human Authentication and Session Security
approvedItems.description: Create persistent local accounts and revocable authenticated sessions with safe credential storage and controlled migration from the current reviewer roster. ACCEL-20261024 residual extension: Specify accepted human provisioning/recovery and session authority needed by external workflows without inferring native/operator qualification.
acceptance_criteria: Persist distinct human principal IDs with hardened password verifiers; never store raw credentials or sessions in repository files.
Enforce secure session expiry, rotation, revocation, CSRF defenses, and reauthentication for sensitive operations.
Provide a recoverable bootstrap and reviewer migration with fail-closed malformed configuration and negative authentication tests.
D211-P1 | lead_owner=DMK-211 | Approved human enrollment records explicit consent and unique principal/session under current credential/recovery policy without a model key.
D211-P2 | lead_owner=DMK-211 | Session revocation/rotation/restart fencing invalidates external action admission at next request and retry.
D211-N1 | lead_owner=DMK-211 | Agent, imported user identity, GitHub actor or header cannot authenticate as an independent human.
D211-N2 | lead_owner=DMK-211 | Missing clean native/environment qualification or enrollment consent blocks operator acceptance without blocking non-applying planning.

approvedItems.title: Configurable Project-Scoped RBAC and Custom Role Restrictions
approvedItems.description: Provide built-in and custom roles with server-registered capabilities, configurable explicit restrictions, scoped grants and non-bypassable governance invariants. ACCEL-20261024 residual extension: Extend current policy with complete source ACL intersection, discover-existence, action scope and revocation-aware delivery/projections.
acceptance_criteria: Allow authorized administrators to configure custom role metadata, capabilities, restrictions, principal type, resource scopes and revision/audit history.
Enforce deny-by-default and explicit-deny precedence with server-side authorization on every protected operation.
Reject self-escalation, unauthorized role delegation, agent human-signoff, bypassed separation of duties and cross-project authorization.
D212-P1 | lead_owner=DMK-212 | Derived outputs from two same-class sources require current read permission to every contributing source plus target policy with explicit denies.
D212-P2 | lead_owner=DMK-212 | Recheck membership/source read and existence on send/queue/deliver/read/search/export/render; revoke caches/queued notifications when one source access changes.
D212-N1 | lead_owner=DMK-212 | Denied existence produces no pointer/title/count/unread badge/notification/caption or attributable timing detail.
D212-N2 | lead_owner=DMK-212 | Paraphrase, missing citation or sanitization cannot declassify; require authorized human exact-source/output/audience decision.

approvedItems.title: Local API Security Perimeter and Route Authorization
approvedItems.description: Classify all API routes and protect privileged endpoints; default local service to loopback unless secure network mode is explicitly configured. ACCEL-20261024 residual extension: Admit all external transports through one action policy and current per-operation skill consultation/receipt; absorb candidate04.
acceptance_criteria: Bind the local server to 127.0.0.1 by default; wider network exposure requires an explicit secure deployment configuration.
Deny unauthenticated and unauthorized access to privileged secrets, Git operations, exports, administration, and project mutations.
Inventory every registered API route with action/resource policy and pass negative authorization regression tests.

D209-P1 | lead_owner=DMK-209 | Before every project operation, including scoped reads, consult current applicable descriptions/required versions and issue a receipt bound to actor/client/session/task/body/policy/skill revisions with expiry, except explicitly enumerated public discovery/authenticated bootstrap reads.

D209-P2 | lead_owner=DMK-209 | Explicit public discovery reveals only public availability/protocol metadata; authenticated scoped bootstrap content reads use a fixed nonrecursive receipt exemption and cannot mutate.
D209-N1 | lead_owner=DMK-209 | Changed content/task/policy/skill/grant or revocation invalidates receipt and denies retry until refreshed.
D209-N2 | lead_owner=DMK-209 | Bootstrap cannot read forbidden skill/private project metadata, enroll authority, recursively demand itself or bypass privileged route denials.
D209-N3 | lead_owner=DMK-209 | A scoped project read with missing/stale required consultation, context or receipt fails before disclosure; read-only operation is not a blanket exemption.

approvedItems.title: Distinct AI Agent Identity and Scoped Delegation
approvedItems.description: Bind agents to non-human identities, bounded permissions, expiring delegated authority and tamper-evident audit, with human governance actions nondelegable. ACCEL-20261024 residual extension: Bind durable agent principal to sponsor/delegation and separate client/session identity with revocation and reconnect.
acceptance_criteria: Agent authority must be independently scoped and cannot exceed the delegator's authorized permissions.
Delegations must support expiration, revocation, explicit project/resource scopes and attributable audit events.
Reject agent impersonation, forged human sign-off, stale delegations and cross-project execution; defer peer federation to a separate ratified decision.
D213-P1 | lead_owner=DMK-213 | Authorized enrollment binds stable agent principal, sponsor/project grant and separate client/session IDs; reconnect resolves the existing principal.
D213-P2 | lead_owner=DMK-213 | Revoke one session independently and revoke sponsor/delegation across all sessions with audit and current policy checks.

D213-N2 | lead_owner=DMK-213 | Duplicate reconnect, retired sponsor or revoked session cannot create another active profile/grant or restore authority.
